create_TurboQuantConfig: create a TurboQuantConfig instance with custom head_dim, key_quant_bits, and value_quant_bits
build_config_from_preset: build a TurboQuantConfig from a named preset like turboquant_k8v4 or turboquant_4bit_nc
calculate_slot_size: calculate the packed slot size in bytes for a TurboQuant KV-cache configuration
get_boundary_skip_layers: get boundary layer indices to skip TurboQuant compression for a given number of model layers
check_key_fp8_mode: check whether a TurboQuantConfig uses FP8 key storage instead of MSE quantization
